definition_en: giving attention to what you do so that nothing goes wrong
core_image: 端着一杯满水，眼睛一直盯着杯沿
scene: 过马路时要小心。Be careful when you cross the road.
sceneCN: 这里 careful 是「小心的」（第 1 个义项：注意避免危险或错误）；句意是过马路时要小心。

derivatives.zh: careful 加 -ly 构成，义为「小心地、仔细地」
careful 加 -ness 构成，义为「谨慎、细心」
careful 的基础词，义为「关心、小心」

senses.title: Avoiding danger or mistakes
senses.definition: paying attention so that you do not hurt yourself or damage something
senses.definitionCN: 集中注意力，以免伤到自己或损坏东西
senses.example: Be careful with the hot pan.
senses.exampleCN: 小心那个烫锅。
senses.why: Care plus -ful means full of care, and care first meant anxious attention.
senses.whyCN: care 加 -ful 意为「充满关切」，而 care 最初指带着焦虑的留意。

senses.title: Doing something with attention to detail
senses.definition: done with thought and attention so that details are correct
senses.definitionCN: 做事时用心留意，使细节都正确
senses.example: She gave the report a careful reading.
senses.exampleCN: 她把报告仔细读了一遍。
senses.why: The same watchfulness that avoids danger also catches small errors in work.
senses.whyCN: 用来避开危险的同一份留心，也能在工作里发现细小错误。

intro.en: Careful is a native compound: care plus the suffix -ful, meaning full of care.
intro.cn: careful 是本族语的复合形式：care 加上后缀 -ful，意为「充满关切」。

items.en: caru meant sorrow and anxious attention.
items.cn: caru 意为悲伤与焦虑的留意。

items.en: care added the sense of protective attention and caution.
items.cn: care 增加了保护性关注与谨慎的含义。

items.en: carefull appeared, meaning full of care, often in the older sense of anxious.
items.cn: carefull 出现，意为「充满关切的」，常带较古的「忧虑」意味。

items.en: The meaning settled on attentive and cautious rather than worried.
items.cn: 词义稳定为「留心的、谨慎的」，而不再是「忧虑的」。

items.en: Today careful covers both avoiding danger and attending to detail.
items.cn: 今天的 careful 既指避开危险，也指注意细节。

note.en: Careful belongs to the care family, and its near meanings split caution from thoroughness.
note.cn: careful 属于 care 词族，近义词把「谨慎」与「细致」区分开。

entries.definition: not giving enough attention
entries.definitionCN: 粗心的、不在意的，由 care 加 -less 构成，是 careful 的反义形式。

entries.definition: in a careful way
entries.definitionCN: 小心地、仔细地，由 careful 加 -ly 构成。

entries.definition: concern, protection, or caution
entries.definitionCN: 关心、照料或小心，是 careful 的基础词。

entries.definition: avoiding danger or risk
entries.definitionCN: 避开危险或风险的，更强调「防风险」。

entries.definition: paying close attention to something
entries.definitionCN: 专注留意的，更贴近「仔细」这一义。

entries.definition: complete, with every detail checked
entries.definitionCN: 彻底的、每个细节都检查过的。

normalIntro.en: Care plus -ful is easy to see: full of care means full of attention.
normalIntro.cn: care 加 -ful 一眼可见：充满关切，就是充满留意。

normal.en: careful is simply care plus the suffix -ful, full of.
normal.cn: careful 就是 care 加后缀 -ful（充满…的）。

normal.en: The opposite is careless, built with -less, without.
normal.cn: 反义词是 careless，用 -less（没有…的）构成。

normal.en: The adverb carefully adds -ly and keeps the same meaning.
normal.cn: 副词 carefully 加 -ly，意思不变。

normal.en: The pattern be careful with takes a noun, while be careful to takes a verb.
normal.cn: be careful with 后接名词，be careful to 后接动词。

normal.en: Careful uses more and most rather than -er and -est.
normal.cn: careful 的比较级和最高级用 more、most，而不是 -er、-est。

abstract.en: Picture a full cup carried across a room without spilling.
abstract.cn: 想象端着一杯满水穿过房间，一滴不洒。

abstract.en: Picture eyes moving slowly along a line of print to catch every word.
abstract.cn: 想象目光沿着一行字慢慢移动，不放过每个词。

abstract.en: Picture a hand hovering just above a hot stove.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手悬在热炉上方，随时准备缩回。

examples.en: Be careful when you cross the road.
examples.cn: 过马路时要小心。

examples.en: Be careful with the hot pan.
examples.cn: 小心那个烫锅。

examples.en: She gave the report a careful reading.
examples.cn: 她把报告仔细读了一遍。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「开尔福」——心里装满了关怀，做事自然就小心。

root: care（关心、小心）+ -ful（充满…的）；care 源自古英语 caru（忧虑、挂念）。

sensesIntro.en: One watchfulness, two directions: guarding against harm and checking every detail.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一种留心，两个方向：防住伤害，检查细节。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: eyes fixed on a delicate thing while the hands move slowly.
core.cn: 核心意象：眼睛盯着易碎之物，双手慢慢移动。

branches.en: The safety sense: attention kept on possible harm.
branches.cn: 安全义：注意力放在可能的伤害上。

branches.en: The accuracy sense: attention kept on details and correctness.
branches.cn: 准确义：注意力放在细节与正确性上。

branches.en: Both senses are the same care, pointed at danger or at detail.
branches.cn: 两个义项是同一种 care，只是分别指向危险与细节。

branches.en: careful driver and be careful with are the everyday patterns.
branches.cn: careful driver 与 be careful with 是日常最常见的用法。

branches.en: careful reading and careful planning show the detail sense in action.
branches.cn: careful reading 与 careful planning 展示了「细致」义的用法。

intro.en: Careful is care plus the suffix -ful, and it in turn takes -ly and -ness.
intro.cn: careful 是 care 加后缀 -ful，它本身又能加 -ly 与 -ness。

latinIntro.en: Careful is native English, so there is no Latin root to list.
latinIntro.cn: careful 是英语本族词，因此没有可列的拉丁词根。

items.exampleCN: 他的细心救了这次实验。
一句粗心的回复让她难过。

items.example: They spent a carefree summer by the sea.
items.exampleCN: 他们在海边度过了一个无忧无虑的夏天。
他是一位关心学生的老师。

items.example: Caru is the oldest form of care.
items.exampleCN: caru 是 care 最古老的形式。

definition_en: in a way that shows attention and avoids mistakes or danger
core_image: 放慢动作，一步一步把事做稳
scene: 她小心地把杯子放回架子上。She carefully placed the cup back on the shelf.
sceneCN: 这里 carefully 是「小心地」（第 1 个义项：动作谨慎、避免碰坏东西）；句意是她小心地把杯子放回架子上。

derivatives.zh: carefully 的基础形容词，义为「小心的、仔细的」
careful 加 -ness 构成，义为「谨慎、细心」
整个词族的基础词，义为「关心、小心」

senses.title: In a way that avoids harm
senses.definition: with attention so that nothing is broken, hurt, or lost
senses.definitionCN: 带着注意力，使东西不被弄坏、人不受伤害
senses.example: He carried the vase carefully to the table.
senses.exampleCN: 他小心地把花瓶搬到桌上。
senses.why: The adverb simply applies careful to an action, and careful means full of care.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词只是把 careful 用在动作上，而 careful 本义是「充满关切」。

senses.title: With attention to detail
senses.definition: with close attention so that every detail is correct
senses.definitionCN: 密切关注，使每个细节都正确
senses.example: Read the question carefully before you answer.
senses.exampleCN: 回答之前先仔细读题。
senses.why: The same attention that protects objects also protects accuracy in thought and work.
senses.whyCN: 保护物品的同一份注意力，也保护思考与工作中的准确性。

intro.en: Carefully is a transparent adverb: careful plus -ly, built on the old word care.
intro.cn: carefully 是词义透明的副词：careful 加 -ly，根基是古老的 care。

items.en: caru meant sorrow and anxious attention.
items.cn: caru 意为悲伤与焦虑的留意。

items.en: care took on the sense of protective attention and caution.
items.cn: care 获得了保护性关注与谨慎的含义。

items.en: carefull appeared as an adjective meaning full of care.
items.cn: 形容词 carefull 出现，意为「充满关切的」。

items.en: The adverb carefully was formed by adding -ly, as with most English adjectives.
items.cn: 副词 carefully 由加 -ly 构成，和多数英语形容词一样。

items.en: Today carefully covers both physical caution and mental thoroughness.
items.cn: 今天的 carefully 同时覆盖动作上的谨慎和思考上的细致。

note.en: Carefully is the adverb of care, and its near meanings differ in what kind of attention they name.
note.cn: carefully 是 care 词族的副词，近义词的区别在于强调哪种留意。

entries.definition: giving attention to avoid mistakes
entries.definitionCN: 小心的、仔细的，是 carefully 的基础形容词。

entries.definition: not giving enough attention
entries.definitionCN: 粗心的，carefully 的反义对应词。

entries.definition: the quality of being careful
entries.definitionCN: 谨慎、细心，是这一词族的抽象名词。

entries.definition: in a way that avoids risk
entries.definitionCN: 谨慎地、避开风险地，更强调防危险。

entries.definition: with close attention
entries.definitionCN: 专注地、留心地，更贴近「仔细」义。

entries.definition: completely, with every detail checked
entries.definitionCN: 彻底地、每个细节都检查到地。

normalIntro.en: Add -ly to careful and the adverb is done; the meaning stays full of care.
normalIntro.cn: 在 careful 后加 -ly 就得到这个副词，意思仍是「充满关切」。

normal.en: carefully is careful plus -ly, the standard way to make an adverb.
normal.cn: carefully 是 careful 加 -ly，构成副词的标准方式。

normal.en: The base careful is care plus -ful, full of care.
normal.cn: 基础词 careful 是 care 加 -ful，意为「充满关切」。

normal.en: The opposite is carelessly, built on careless.
normal.cn: 反义词是 carelessly，来自 careless。

normal.en: It often sits before a verb: carefully placed, carefully worded.
normal.cn: 它常放在动词前：carefully placed（小心放置）、carefully worded（措辞谨慎）。

normal.en: As an adverb it has no comparative form of its own; more carefully does the work.
normal.cn: 副词本身没有 -er 形式，比较级用 more carefully。

abstract.en: Picture a hand slowing down just before it sets a glass on a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在把杯子放上桌前，忽然慢了下来。

abstract.en: Picture a finger moving under each line of print as the eyes follow.
abstract.cn: 想象手指在每一行字下移动，眼睛跟着走。

abstract.en: Picture a person testing each step of a dark staircase with one foot.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人用一只脚试探黑楼梯的每一级。

examples.en: She carefully placed the cup back on the shelf.
examples.cn: 她小心地把杯子放回架子上。

examples.en: Read the question carefully before you answer.
examples.cn: 回答之前先仔细读题。

examples.en: The plan was carefully worded to avoid blame.
examples.cn: 这份计划的措辞经过仔细推敲，以避免被指责。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「开尔弗利」——心里挂着事，动作就慢而稳。

root: careful + -ly；care 源自古英语 caru（忧虑、挂念），-ful 意为「充满…的」。

sensesIntro.en: One adverb, two jobs: moving safely and reading closely.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个副词，两项工作：动作上求安全，阅读上求准确。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: movement slowed down by attention.
core.cn: 核心意象：因为留心而放慢的动作。

branches.en: The safety sense: handling things so they do not break.
branches.cn: 安全义：拿放东西时不让它损坏。

branches.en: The accuracy sense: reading and thinking without skipping details.
branches.cn: 准确义：阅读与思考时不漏掉细节。

branches.en: Both senses describe the same slowed, focused action.
branches.cn: 两个义项描写的都是同一种放慢而专注的动作。

branches.en: drive carefully and handle carefully are the common warnings.
branches.cn: 小心驾驶、小心拿放是最常见的提醒说法。

branches.en: carefully planned and carefully worded show the detail sense.
branches.cn: 精心策划与措辞谨慎展示了「细致」这一面。

intro.en: Carefully is built from care by adding -ful and then -ly.
intro.cn: carefully 由 care 先加 -ful、再加 -ly 构成。

latinIntro.en: The whole family is native English, so no Latin entries are listed.
latinIntro.cn: 整个词族都是英语本族词，因此不列拉丁同源词。

items.example: A careless step broke the branch.
He carelessly left the door open.
She did it with great care.
items.exampleCN: 她非常小心地做了这件事。

items.example: The children ran carefree across the field.
items.exampleCN: 孩子们无忧无虑地跑过田野。

items.example: Caru is the old root of the family.
items.exampleCN: caru 是这个词族的古老词根。

definition_en: a thick woven material used to cover floors, or a thick layer of something
core_image: 一块厚布把整片地面铺满
scene: 客厅的地板上铺着一块厚地毯。A thick carpet covered the floor of the living room.
sceneCN: 这里 carpet 是「地毯」（第 1 个义项：铺在地面的厚织物）；句意是客厅的地板上铺着一块厚地毯。

derivatives.zh: carpet 加 -ing 构成，义为「地毯材料；铺地织物」
carpet 加 -ed 构成，义为「铺了地毯的」
carpet 与 bag 复合，义为「旧式旅行毡袋」

senses.title: A thick floor covering
senses.definition: a piece of thick woven material used to cover a floor
senses.definitionCN: 铺在地面上的厚织物
senses.example: The carpet in the hall is old and worn.
senses.exampleCN: 大厅里的地毯又旧又破。
senses.why: The word first named thick woolen cloth, and cloth laid on a floor became a carpet.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指厚毛布，铺在地上的厚布就成了地毯。

senses.title: A thick layer covering a surface
senses.definition: a thick continuous layer of something covering the ground
senses.definitionCN: 厚厚地、连续地盖住地面的一层东西
senses.example: A carpet of fallen leaves covered the path.
senses.exampleCN: 小路上铺满了落叶。
senses.why: A carpet covers a floor completely, so any complete covering can be called a carpet.
senses.whyCN: 地毯把地面整片盖住，因此任何完整覆盖的一层都可以叫 carpet。

intro.en: Carpet goes back to a Latin verb meaning to pluck, because the cloth was made of pulled wool.
intro.cn: carpet 可追溯到拉丁语中表示「撕扯」的动词，因为这种布由扯下的羊毛制成。

items.en: carpere meant to pluck or pull apart, used of wool and fibers.
items.cn: carpere 意为「采摘、扯开」，用于羊毛和纤维。

items.en: carpita named wool or a rough woolen fabric.
items.cn: carpita 指羊毛或粗糙的毛织物。

items.en: carpite named a thick woolen cloth used as a cover.
items.cn: 古法语 carpite 指用作覆盖物的厚毛布。

items.en: English borrowed it as carpet for a table cover, then for a floor covering.
items.cn: 英语借入为 carpet，先指桌布，后指铺地织物。

items.en: The covering sense widened to a carpet of leaves and to carpet as a verb.
items.cn: 覆盖义扩展到「一层落叶」，并产生动词用法。

note.en: Carpet is a cloth word that became a covering word, and it sits beside rug and mat.
note.cn: carpet 由「布」变成「覆盖物」，与 rug、mat 相邻。

entries.definition: material used for making carpets
entries.definitionCN: 制作地毯的材料，由 carpet 加 -ing 构成。

entries.definition: an old-fashioned travelling bag made of carpet material
entries.definitionCN: 旧式旅行毡袋，由 carpet 与 bag 复合而成。

entries.definition: rough woolen cloth in Latin
entries.definitionCN: 拉丁语中的粗毛布，是 carpet 的源头。

entries.definition: a small carpet that does not cover the whole floor
entries.definitionCN: 小块地毯，通常不铺满整个地面。

entries.definition: a small flat piece of material laid on a floor
coarse material woven into mats

normalIntro.en: The word comes from plucked wool: rough cloth first, floor covering later.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词来自被扯下的羊毛：先有粗毛布，后有铺地织物。

normal.en: carpet comes from Latin carpere, to pluck, the same root as excerpt.
normal.cn: carpet 来自拉丁语 carpere（摘、扯），与 excerpt 同根。

normal.en: The first carpets were thick woolen cloths laid over tables or floors.
normal.cn: 最早的地毯是铺在桌上或地上的厚毛布。

normal.en: red carpet is the fixed phrase for an official welcome.
normal.cn: red carpet 是「隆重欢迎」的固定说法。

normal.en: a carpet of leaves uses the covering sense with a named material.
normal.cn: a carpet of leaves 用具体材料来表示「覆盖的一层」。

normal.en: As a verb, carpet means to cover a floor completely.
normal.cn: 作动词时，carpet 指把地面整片铺满。

abstract.en: Picture a thick red cloth laid down a staircase step by step.
abstract.cn: 想象一条厚厚的红布沿着楼梯一级级铺下去。

abstract.en: Picture autumn leaves covering a path so completely that no stone shows.
abstract.cn: 想象秋叶把小路盖得严严实实，一块石头都看不见。

abstract.en: Picture bare feet sinking a little into soft wool.
abstract.cn: 想象赤脚陷进柔软羊毛里一点点。

examples.en: A thick carpet covered the floor of the living room.
examples.cn: 客厅的地板上铺着一块厚地毯。

examples.en: The carpet in the hall is old and worn.
examples.cn: 大厅里的地毯又旧又破。

examples.en: A carpet of fallen leaves covered the path.
examples.cn: 小路上铺满了落叶。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「卡皮特」——皮特把厚厚的布卡在地板上，就是地毯。

root: 拉丁语 carpere（撕扯、摘取）→ carpita（羊毛）→ 古法语 carpite（厚毛布）→ 英语 carpet。

sensesIntro.en: A cloth that covers a floor, then any layer that covers a surface.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是一块铺满地面的布，后来指任何铺满表面的层。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: thick cloth spread until the whole floor disappears.
core.cn: 核心意象：厚布铺开，直到整片地面都不见了。

branches.en: The floor sense: woven material covering a room.
branches.cn: 地面义：覆盖房间地面的织物。

branches.en: The layer sense: leaves, snow, or flowers covering the ground.
branches.cn: 覆盖层义：落叶、雪或花铺满地面。

branches.en: red carpet turns the object into a sign of honour.
branches.cn: red carpet 把物件变成了礼遇的象征。

branches.en: Both senses depend on complete coverage rather than a small patch.
branches.cn: 两个义项都强调「整片盖住」，而不是只铺一小块。

branches.en: The verb carpet extends the same image: to cover a surface thickly.
branches.cn: 动词 carpet 延伸同一画面：厚厚地覆盖一个表面。

intro.en: Carpet is a base noun from Latin; -ing and -ed build its small family.
intro.cn: carpet 是来自拉丁语的基础名词，-ing 与 -ed 构成它不大的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin carpere, to pluck, and carpita, wool, explain the word's origin in pulled fiber.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 carpere（扯下）与 carpita（羊毛）说明这个词源于被扯下的纤维。

definition_en: a long orange root vegetable, or something offered as a reward to persuade someone
core_image: 一根橙色的根从土里被拔出来，还带着泥
scene: 她从地里拔出一根胡萝卜。She pulled a carrot out of the ground.
sceneCN: 这里 carrot 是「胡萝卜」（第 1 个义项：一种橙色根菜）；句意是她从地里拔出一根胡萝卜。

collocations.zh: 胡萝卜加大棒；软硬兼施

derivatives.zh: 由 carrot 的词干构成，义为「胡萝卜素」
carrot 加 -y 构成，义为「胡萝卜色的」
carrot 与 top 复合，口语指「红头发的人」

senses.title: The long orange root vegetable
senses.definition: a long pointed orange root eaten as a vegetable
senses.definitionCN: 一种长而尖的橙色根，作为蔬菜食用
senses.example: She cut the carrot into thin slices.
senses.exampleCN: 她把胡萝卜切成薄片。

senses.title: A reward used to persuade
senses.definition: something attractive offered to persuade someone to act
senses.definitionCN: 用来吸引并说服某人行动的好处
senses.example: The bonus was a carrot to attract new staff.
senses.exampleCN: 奖金是吸引新员工的诱饵。
senses.why: A carrot is held in front of a donkey to make it move, and the image became a metaphor for incentives.
senses.whyCN: 人们把胡萝卜吊在驴子前面让它往前走，这个画面就成了「激励手段」的比喻。

intro.en: Carrot travelled from Greek to Latin to French before reaching English in the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: carrot 从希腊语经拉丁语、法语，在十六世纪进入英语。

items.en: karoton named the carrot plant, a word of uncertain earlier origin.
items.cn: karoton 指胡萝卜这种植物，更早的来源尚不确定。

items.en: carota was the Latin name for the same root vegetable.
items.cn: carota 是拉丁语对同一种根菜的称呼。

items.en: carotte kept the vegetable sense in medieval and early modern French.
items.cn: carotte 在中古及近代早期法语中保留了这一蔬菜义。

items.en: English borrowed the word as carrot, describing the orange root we know.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入为 carrot，指我们今天熟悉的橙色根菜。

items.en: The metaphor of the dangling carrot added the sense of a reward or incentive.
items.cn: 「吊着的胡萝卜」这一比喻又添上了「奖励、激励」的义项。

note.en: Carrot has a chemical relative in carotene, and it sits beside other root vegetables.
note.cn: carrot 在化学词汇里有 carotene 这个亲戚，同时和别的根菜相邻。

entries.definition: the orange substance in carrots that the body turns into vitamin A
entries.definitionCN: 胡萝卜素，胡萝卜中使人体合成维生素甲的橙色物质。

entries.definition: orange-red in colour, like a carrot
entries.definitionCN: 胡萝卜色的，指橙红色，由 carrot 加 -y 构成。

entries.definition: the Latin name for the carrot
entries.definitionCN: 拉丁语中的「胡萝卜」，是英语 carrot 的直接源头。

entries.definition: a round white root vegetable
entries.definitionCN: 圆形的白色根菜，与胡萝卜同属根菜。

entries.definition: a small red or white root with a sharp taste
entries.definitionCN: 小红萝卜或白萝卜，味道辛辣。

entries.definition: a plant grown for food
entries.definitionCN: 作为食物种植的植物，是 carrot 的上位词。

normalIntro.en: One orange root, and a metaphor about donkeys and rewards.
normalIntro.cn: 一根橙色根菜，外加一个关于驴子与奖励的比喻。

normal.en: carrot comes through French carotte from Latin carota.
normal.cn: carrot 经法语 carotte 来自拉丁语 carota。

normal.en: carotene, the orange substance, keeps the same stem.
normal.cn: 橙色的胡萝卜素 carotene 保留了同一个词干。

normal.en: carrot and stick names the two tools of persuasion, reward and threat.
normal.cn: carrot and stick 指奖励与威胁两种手段。

normal.en: grated carrot and carrot cake are common kitchen phrases.
normal.cn: 胡萝卜丝与胡萝卜蛋糕是常见说法。

normal.en: The plural carrots adds only an s.
normal.cn: 复数 carrots 只加一个 s。

abstract.en: Picture a bright orange root pulled from dark soil, soil still clinging to it.
abstract.cn: 想象一根亮橙色的根从黑土里拔出，还带着泥。

abstract.en: Picture a carrot tied to a stick, hanging just ahead of a walking donkey.
abstract.cn: 想象一根胡萝卜系在棍上，吊在行走的驴子前面。

abstract.en: Picture a plate of orange slices next to a green salad.
abstract.cn: 想象一盘橙色薄片旁边放着一份绿色沙拉。

examples.en: She pulled a carrot out of the ground.
examples.cn: 她从地里拔出一根胡萝卜。

examples.en: She cut the carrot into thin slices.
examples.cn: 她把胡萝卜切成薄片。

examples.en: The bonus was a carrot to attract new staff.
examples.cn: 奖金是吸引新员工的诱饵。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「开罗特」——开罗的市场里，特多这种橙色的根菜。

root: 希腊语 karoton → 拉丁语 carota → 法语 carotte → 英语 carrot；同族词有 carotene。

sensesIntro.en: The vegetable comes first; the reward metaphor hangs it in front of someone.
sensesIntro.cn: 先有这种蔬菜，后来「奖励」的比喻把它吊在了人面前。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long orange root lifted out of the earth.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根长长的橙色根从土里被拔起。

branches.en: The food sense: the orange root eaten raw or cooked.
branches.cn: 食物义：可生吃或熟食的橙色根菜。

branches.en: The incentive sense: a reward dangled to produce action.
branches.cn: 激励义：吊在前面促使人行动的好处。

branches.en: carrot juice and carrot cake show the vegetable in compounds.
branches.cn: 胡萝卜汁与胡萝卜蛋糕展示了这种蔬菜的复合用法。

branches.en: The metaphor works because the vegetable is bright, cheap, and easy to dangle.
branches.cn: 这个比喻成立，是因为胡萝卜颜色醒目、便宜、又容易吊起来。

branches.en: carrot and stick pairs the reward with a threat.
branches.cn: carrot and stick 把奖励与威胁配成一对。

intro.en: Carrot is a base noun of Greek origin; -y and compounds build its family.
intro.cn: carrot 是源自希腊语的基础名词，词族靠 -y 与复合构词扩展。

latinIntro.en: Latin carota is the bridge between Greek karoton and English carrot.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 carota 是希腊语 karoton 与英语 carrot 之间的桥。

items.example: The soup contains carrot and onion.
items.exampleCN: 这汤里有胡萝卜和洋葱。

items.example: The field was full of carrots.

items.meaning: the orange pigment found in carrots
items.example: Carotene gives the vegetable its colour.
items.exampleCN: 胡萝卜素赋予这种蔬菜颜色。
那孩子长着一头橙红色的头发。

items.meaning: an informal name for a person with red hair
items.meaningCN: 口语中对红头发者的称呼
items.example: They called him carrot-top at school.
items.exampleCN: 上学时大家叫他红头发。

items.example: Carota passed into French as carotte.
items.exampleCN: carota 进入法语后成为 carotte。

items.example: Karoton is the earliest known form.
items.exampleCN: karoton 是目前已知最早的形式。

items.example: The stew had turnip and beef.
items.exampleCN: 这锅炖菜有芜菁和牛肉。

definition_en: to hold something and take it from one place to another
core_image: 双手把东西抱起来，一路带到别处
scene: 他两手抱着箱子走上楼。He carried the box upstairs in both arms.
sceneCN: 这里 carried 是 carry 的过去式，意为「搬运、抱着」（第 1 个义项：用手拿着东西移动）；句意是他两手抱着箱子走上楼。

derivatives.zh: carry 加 -er 构成，义为「承运人、携带者」
与 carry 同根，义为「马车；车厢；运输」
同根名词，义为「船货、货物」

senses.title: To hold and move something
senses.definition: to hold something in your hands or arms while you move
senses.definitionCN: 移动时用手或手臂拿着某物
senses.example: She carried the baby up the stairs.
senses.exampleCN: 她抱着婴儿上楼。
senses.why: The word came from a verb meaning to transport, and the simplest form is carrying by hand.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自表示「运送」的动词，最基本的形式就是用手搬运。

senses.title: To transport goods or passengers
senses.definition: to take goods or people from one place to another in a vehicle
senses.definitionCN: 用交通工具把货物或人从一处运到另一处
senses.example: The train carries hundreds of passengers each day.
senses.exampleCN: 这列火车每天运送数百名乘客。
senses.why: The same verb widens from a person's hands to a ship, train, or plane.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动词从人的双手扩展到船、火车和飞机。

senses.title: To support the weight of something
senses.definition: to support the weight or burden of something
senses.definitionCN: 支撑某物的重量或负担
senses.example: These pillars carry the weight of the roof.
senses.exampleCN: 这些柱子承受屋顶的重量。
senses.why: If you carry a load, you bear its weight, and pillars and beams do the same.
senses.whyCN: 人搬东西时要承受重量，柱子和横梁做的是同一件事。

intro.en: Carry entered English from northern French, and its root goes back to the Latin wagon.
intro.cn: carry 从法国北方方言进入英语，词根可追溯到拉丁语的「车」。

items.en: carrus named a wagon, the distant source of the carrying family.
items.cn: carrus 指马车，是这组「运送」词汇的远源。

items.en: carricare meant to load a cart with goods.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 carricare 意为「往车上装货」。

items.en: carier meant to transport or convey, and it was this form that crossed the Channel.
items.cn: 古北法语 carier 意为「运送、传送」，正是这个形式渡过了海峡。

items.en: carien became the everyday English verb for carrying.
items.cn: carien 成为英语中日常表示「携带」的动词。

items.en: The verb widened to vehicles, loads, responsibilities, and fixed phrases such as carry out.
items.cn: 这个动词扩展到交通工具、负载、责任，以及 carry out 等固定搭配。

note.en: Carry is the base of carrier, carriage, and cargo, and its near meanings split holding from transporting.
note.cn: carry 是 carrier、carriage、cargo 的基础，近义词则把「拿着」与「运输」区分开。

entries.definition: a person or company that transports goods
entries.definitionCN: 承运人、运输公司，由 carry 加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: a horse-drawn vehicle or a railway car
entries.definitionCN: 马车或火车车厢，与 carry 同根。

entries.definition: goods carried by ship or aircraft
entries.definitionCN: 船货、货物，与 carry 同出 carricare。

entries.definition: to carry or support a weight
entries.definitionCN: 承载或支撑重量，比 carry 更书面。

entries.definition: to move goods or people in vehicles
entries.definitionCN: 用交通工具运送货物或人，对应第二个义项。

entries.definition: to keep something in your hands
entries.definitionCN: 把东西拿在手里，是 carry 动作的起点。

normalIntro.en: A short verb whose family shows every stage: hand, vehicle, pillar, phrase.
normalIntro.cn: 一个短动词，词族展示了它的每一站：手、车、柱子、短语。

normal.en: carry, carrier, carriage, and cargo all share one root, from Latin carricare.
normal.cn: carry、carrier、carriage、cargo 共享一个词根，来自拉丁语 carricare。

normal.en: carry on means continue, as if carrying the work forward.
normal.cn: carry on 意为「继续」，像把工作继续搬着往前走。

normal.en: carry out means perform, taking a plan from paper into action.
normal.cn: carry out 意为「执行」，把计划从纸上搬进行动。

normal.en: Pillars carry a roof, which links the verb to support.
normal.cn: 柱子 carry 屋顶，这就把动词和「支撑」连了起来。

normal.en: The third person carries changes y to ies.
normal.cn: 第三人称 carries 把 y 变成 ies。

abstract.en: Picture both arms wrapped around a heavy box, steps slow and even.
abstract.cn: 想象双臂环抱一个重箱子，脚步缓慢而平稳。

abstract.en: Picture a ship moving across water with the weight of goods inside it.
abstract.cn: 想象一艘船载着货物的重量在水面上行进。

abstract.en: Picture a stone pillar holding up a roof without any visible effort.
abstract.cn: 想象一根石柱不动声色地撑起屋顶。

examples.en: He carried the box upstairs in both arms.
examples.cn: 他两手抱着箱子走上楼。

examples.en: The train carries hundreds of passengers each day.
examples.cn: 这列火车每天运送数百名乘客。

examples.en: These pillars carry the weight of the roof.
examples.cn: 这些柱子承受屋顶的重量。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「开瑞」——双手一开一合，把东西一路抱走。

root: 古北法语 carier（运送）→ 中古英语 carien；源头为晚期拉丁语 carricare（装车）与 carrus（车）。

sensesIntro.en: Hands, vehicles, and pillars all carry: they hold something and bear its weight elsewhere.
sensesIntro.cn: 手、车、柱子都在 carry：拿着某物，并把它的重量承住。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: arms wrapped around a load, moving it steadily.
core.cn: 核心意象：双臂环抱着负载，稳稳地移动。

branches.en: The hand sense: holding something while walking.
branches.cn: 手工义：边走边拿着东西。

branches.en: The vehicle sense: a train or ship moving goods and people.
branches.cn: 交通义：火车或船运送货物与人。

branches.en: The structural sense: a pillar bearing weight.
branches.cn: 结构义：柱子承受重量。

branches.en: All senses share holding plus bearing, whether by hand, engine, or stone.
branches.cn: 三个义项都包含「拿着并承重」，只是靠手、发动机还是石头。

branches.en: Phrases such as carry out and carry on extend the verb into abstract action.
branches.cn: carry out 与 carry on 等短语把这个动词延伸到抽象行动。

intro.en: Carry is a base verb; -er and -age build its main noun family.
intro.cn: carry 是基础动词，-er 与 -age 构成它的主要名词词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin carrus and carricare supply the root for carry, carrier, carriage, and cargo.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 carrus 与 carricare 为 carry、carrier、carriage、cargo 提供词根。

items.meaning: to hold and take something somewhere
items.example: Can you carry this bag for me?

items.meaning: held and moved in the past
the act of holding and moving something
items.example: He came in carrying a box.

items.meaning: a person or thing that carries
a vehicle or the act of transporting
goods carried by ship or aircraft

items.meaningCN: 运送，是 carry 的直接来源

definition_zh: 动画片；漫画；讽刺画；草图
definition_en: a film made from a series of drawings, or a drawing that tells a joke or a story
core_image: 先画在硬纸板上的草图，后来一帧帧动了起来
scene: 孩子放学回家，丢下书包就打开电视。He laughed at the cartoon playing on Saturday morning.
sceneCN: 这里 cartoon 指「动画片」（第 1 个义项：由连续图画拍成的影片）；句意是他看着周六早上播放的动画片笑了。

senses.title: An animated film
senses.definition: a film made by photographing a series of drawings so that they appear to move
senses.definitionCN: 把一连串图画拍摄下来、使其看起来会动的影片
senses.example: The children watch a cartoon every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们每天早上都看动画片。
senses.why: The core image of drawings on strong paper turns into motion once those drawings are filmed in sequence.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是画在厚纸上的图画，当这些图画被连续拍摄，它就动了起来。

senses.title: A humorous drawing
senses.definition: a drawing in a newspaper or magazine that makes a joke or comments on events
senses.definitionCN: 报纸或杂志上带有玩笑或评论意味的图画
senses.example: The paper printed a cartoon about the election.
senses.exampleCN: 报纸刊登了一幅关于选举的漫画。
senses.why: A single strong drawing keeps the paper sketch but adds a caption and a target to laugh at.
senses.whyCN: 单幅有力的图画保留了纸面草图，又加上文字说明和嘲讽对象。

senses.title: A preparatory sketch
senses.definition: a full-size drawing made as a preparation for a painting or tapestry
senses.definitionCN: 为绘画或挂毯所作的等大预备图稿
senses.example: The museum keeps the cartoon for the ceiling fresco.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆保存着那幅天顶壁画的底稿。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: the sketch was literally drawn on cartone, a sheet of strong paper.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项：草图字面上就画在 cartone，也就是一张厚纸板上。

intro.en: Cartoon travels from Latin paper to Italian cardboard to a French drawing sheet, and only later picks up its comic and animated senses.
intro.cn: cartoon 从拉丁语的纸，到意大利语的厚纸板，再到法语的大幅画纸，很晚才获得漫画与动画的含义。

items.en: Charta meant papyrus or paper and underlies many European words for paper and card.
items.cn: 拉丁语 charta 指纸草或纸张，是许多欧洲语言中纸与卡片类词的源头。

items.en: Cartone, an augmentative of carta, named a large sheet of strong paper or cardboard.
items.cn: 意大利语 cartone 由 carta 加大后缀构成，指一大张厚纸或纸板。

items.en: French carton carried the word into the language of art workshops as a full-size drawing on paper.
items.cn: 法语 carton 把该词带进画坊用语，指画在纸上的等大图稿。

items.en: English borrowed cartoon for a preparatory drawing, especially one for a fresco or tapestry.
items.cn: 英语在十七世纪借入 cartoon，指壁画或挂毯的预备图稿。

items.en: Punch magazine applied the word to humorous drawings, and the comic sense took over.
items.cn: 十九世纪《笨拙》杂志用它指幽默图画，漫画义由此流行。

items.en: Filmed drawings added the animated sense in the twentieth century, now the most familiar one.
items.cn: 二十世纪活动的图画电影又添上动画片义，如今这是最熟悉的用法。

note.en: The first group follows the paper-and-card root, the second gathers other kinds of comic or animated pictures.
note.cn: 第一组沿纸与纸板的词根展开，第二组收其他漫画与动画类图画。

entries.definition: a container made of cardboard
an artist who draws cartoons
exaggerated in the style of a cartoon
the technique of making drawings or models appear to move
entries.definitionCN: 让图画或模型看起来会动的技术

entries.definition: a magazine or strip of drawings telling a funny story
entries.definitionCN: 讲述滑稽故事的漫画刊物或连环画

entries.definition: a drawing that exaggerates a person's features for comic effect
entries.definitionCN: 夸张人物特征以取得滑稽效果的画像

normalIntro.en: These hooks rest on the cardboard root, the fixed compounds and the artist suffixes.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子依托纸板这一词根、固定复合词以及表示画者的后缀。

normal.en: Cartoon and carton share a root: a cartoon began as a drawing on strong cardboard.
normal.cn: cartoon 与 carton 同根：漫画最初就画在厚纸板上。

normal.en: The suffix -ist makes cartoonist, a person, just as it does in artist and pianist.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ist 构成 cartoonist，表示人，和 artist、pianist 一样。

normal.en: Animated cartoon spells out the moving-picture sense inside the phrase.
normal.cn: animated cartoon 这一搭配直接把会动的影片义写了出来。

normal.en: Political cartoon fixes the newspaper sense with a clear target.
normal.cn: political cartoon 用明确的嘲讽对象固定了报纸漫画义。

normal.en: The ending -oon also appears in balloon and lagoon, all words borrowed from French or Italian.
normal.cn: 词尾 -oon 也出现在 balloon 和 lagoon 里，这些词都借自法语或意大利语。

abstract.en: Picture a stack of drawings flipped quickly until the figures run.
abstract.cn: 想象一叠画稿被快速翻动，画中人竟然跑了起来。

abstract.en: Picture a small boxed drawing in the corner of a newspaper.
abstract.cn: 想象报纸角落里一幅加了框的小画。

abstract.en: Picture a painter sketching a huge design on thick grey paper.
abstract.cn: 想象画师在厚厚的灰纸上勾出巨大的图样。

examples.en: My sister draws a cartoon for the school paper.
examples.cn: 我妹妹为校报画漫画。

examples.en: The cartoon made fun of the mayor.
examples.cn: 那幅漫画拿市长开玩笑。

examples.en: He watched cartoons all afternoon.
examples.cn: 他整个下午都在看动画片。

dict_mnemonic.text: cartoon 开头像 cart（车）：把它想成一辆装满画稿的小车，一开动就变成了动画。

root: 意大利语 cartone（厚纸板）经法语进入英语，本义是画在厚纸上的大幅草图，后指漫画与动画片。

sensesIntro.en: The paper sketch gives a preparatory drawing, a newspaper joke and finally a filmed sequence of drawings.
sensesIntro.cn: 纸上的草图先长成预备图稿，再长成报纸上的笑话，最后长成连续拍摄的动画。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a drawing made on a sheet of strong paper.
core.cn: 核心意象：画在一张厚纸上的图画。

branches.en: The earliest sense keeps the drawing and the paper untouched.
branches.cn: 最早的义项原样保留了图画与纸张。

branches.en: A caption and a target turn the sketch into a joke.
branches.cn: 加上说明文字与嘲讽对象，草图就变成了笑话。

branches.en: Filming many drawings in order adds motion to the same image.
branches.cn: 把许多图画按顺序拍摄，就给同一画面加上了运动。

branches.en: Both senses stay on paper, one as preparation and one as comment.
branches.cn: 这两个义项都留在纸面上，一个用于准备，一个用于评论。

branches.en: Both are popular visual stories, one static and one moving.
branches.cn: 两者都是通俗的视觉故事，一个静止，一个会动。

intro.en: Cartoon forms a small family through inflection, the artist suffix and two adjective endings.
intro.cn: cartoon 通过屈折变化、表人后缀和两个形容词词尾形成一个小词族。

latinIntro.en: The deeper source is Latin charta, paper, which also gives chart and charter.
latinIntro.cn: 更深的源头是拉丁语 charta（纸），chart 与 charter 也出自这里。

items.meaning: a comic drawing or animated film

items.example: The villain had a cartoonish laugh.
items.exampleCN: 那个反派笑得十分夸张。

definition_zh: 情况；实例；案件；病例；箱子
definition_en: a particular situation, an instance of something, a matter decided in court, or a container that holds something
core_image: 一个把内容罩住的框：事情落进来，东西装进去
scene: 会议上大家都在讨论同一个问题。In this case, the manager agreed to wait another week.
sceneCN: 这里 case 指「情况」（第 1 个义项：某种具体情形）；句意是在这种情况下，经理同意再等一周。

pos.zh: 情况；实例；案件；病例；箱子

senses.title: A particular situation
senses.definition: a particular situation or set of circumstances that exists at a certain time
senses.definitionCN: 某一时刻存在的特定情形或一组状况
senses.example: In that case, we should leave early.
senses.exampleCN: 既然那样，我们该早点走。
senses.why: The Latin source meant something that falls out, and a situation is exactly what has fallen into place.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语源义是「落下来的事」，而情况正是落到眼前、摆在那里的事。

senses.title: An example or instance
senses.definition: a single example of something happening, especially in an argument or report
senses.definitionCN: 某事发生的一个单独例子，尤用于论证或报告
senses.example: The report lists several cases of fraud.
senses.exampleCN: 报告列出了好几起欺诈实例。
senses.why: One fallen event can stand as a sample for a whole class of events.
senses.whyCN: 一件落下来的事可以充当一整类事件的样本。

senses.title: A matter for a court
senses.definition: a question or dispute that is brought before a court of law
senses.definitionCN: 提交到法庭审理的问题或纠纷
senses.example: The lawyer took the case without a fee.
senses.exampleCN: 律师免费接了这桩案子。
senses.why: A legal case is simply one situation singled out and placed before a judge.
senses.whyCN: 法律案件无非是被单独挑出来、送到法官面前的一种情形。

senses.title: A patient or an illness
senses.definition: a person suffering from an illness, or an occurrence of a disease recorded by a doctor
senses.definitionCN: 患某种病的人，或医生记录的一次发病
senses.example: The clinic reported three new cases of flu.
senses.exampleCN: 诊所报告了三例新的流感病例。
senses.why: Medicine counts each separate instance of illness, so the instance sense is applied to patients.
senses.whyCN: 医学把每一次发病都单独计数，于是「实例」义就用到了病人身上。

senses.title: A container that holds something
senses.definition: a container designed to hold and protect a particular object
senses.definitionCN: 为装放并保护某物而设计的容器
senses.example: He put the violin back in its case.
senses.exampleCN: 他把小提琴放回琴盒。
senses.why: This sense has a different source, Latin capsa, a box, and only later merged in spelling with the situation word.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项另有来源，拉丁语 capsa 就是盒子，后来才在拼写上并入表示情况的词。

intro.en: Case in English is two words in one shape: an event word from Latin casus and a container word from Latin capsa.
intro.cn: 英语里的 case 是两种词形合一：表示事件的词来自拉丁语 casus，表示容器的词来自拉丁语 capsa。

items.en: Casus meant a fall or something that befalls, from cadere, to fall.
items.cn: 拉丁语 casus 意为落下或落到头上的事，源自动词 cadere（落下）。

items.en: Capsa meant a box or case, and also gives English capsule and cash.
items.cn: 拉丁语 capsa 意为盒子或箱子，也是英语 capsule 与 cash 的来源。

items.en: Old French cas carried the event sense into English after the Norman period.
items.cn: 诺曼征服之后，古法语 cas 把事件义带进了英语。

items.en: Middle English case covers both a happening and a box, the two strands now spelled alike.
items.cn: 中古英语的 case 同时指发生的事和盒子，两条线此时拼写已经相同。

items.en: Legal and medical usage fixes the court case and the patient case as standard phrases.
items.cn: 十六至十八世纪，法律与医学用法把法庭案件和病例固定为常见说法。

items.en: Modern grammars and manuals add case study, casework and other compound labels.
items.cn: 现代语法书和手册又添上个案研究、个案工作等复合说法。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the container branch, while the meaning group gathers words for situations and disputes.
note.cn: 形近组沿容器这一支展开，近义组收表示情形与纠纷的词。

entries.definition: a protective outer cover
a window that opens on hinges
social work done with individual clients
entries.definitionCN: 针对个别对象开展的社会工作

entries.definition: the set of conditions at a particular time
a single example of something
a claim brought to a court for judgment

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the fixed phrase in case, the falling root and the separate box root.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用固定搭配 in case、表示落下的词根，以及另一个表示盒子的词根。

normal.en: In case is a set phrase meaning just in case something happens, not a case in a court.
normal.cn: in case 是固定说法，意为以防万一，与法庭案件无关。

normal.en: The event sense comes from cadere, to fall, so a case is something that falls into your path.
normal.cn: 事件义来自 cadere（落下），所以 case 就是落到你眼前的事。

normal.en: The box sense comes from capsa, which also gives capsule, a small case for medicine.
normal.cn: 箱子义来自 capsa，capsule（胶囊）也是这个词源。

normal.en: Case study, court case and pencil case each fix one sense in a familiar phrase.
normal.cn: case study、court case、pencil case 各自把一个义项固定在熟悉的搭配里。

normal.en: Only the plural cases is needed for the noun, so the form list stays short.
normal.cn: 名词只需要复数 cases，所以形式表很短。

abstract.en: Picture a folder dropped on a desk with all the facts inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一个文件夹落在桌上，里面装满了事实。

abstract.en: Picture a violin lying in a velvet-lined box.
abstract.cn: 想象一把小提琴躺在铺着绒布的盒子里。

abstract.en: Picture a judge holding up one thin file among many.
abstract.cn: 想象法官从许多档案中举起薄薄的一份。

examples.en: In most cases the train arrives on time.
examples.cn: 大多数情况下火车都准点到达。

examples.en: The police are still working on the case.
examples.cn: 警方仍在处理这起案件。

examples.en: Put your glasses back in the case.
examples.cn: 把眼镜放回眼镜盒里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 case 想成一个带锁的盒子：里面装着情况、案件和病例这些内容。

root: 情况义源自拉丁语 casus（落下、发生的事），箱子义源自拉丁语 capsa（盒），两个词在英语中同形合并。

sensesIntro.en: From one fallen event grow the instance, the situation, the court case and the medical case, while a separate box root adds the container.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一件落下的事长出实例、情况、案件和病例，另一支表示盒子的词根则添上容器义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a frame that holds what falls into it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个把落进来的东西框住的外壳。

branches.en: A situation is the whole set of things that have fallen into place.
branches.cn: 情况就是已经落到位置上的一整套事情。

branches.en: An instance is one such event picked out and counted.
branches.cn: 实例就是从其中挑出并计数的一件。

branches.en: A court case is the same event handed to a judge.
branches.cn: 案件就是把同一件事交给法官处理。

branches.en: A medical case applies the counting sense to sick patients.
branches.cn: 病例把计数的用法用到了病人身上。

branches.en: The container sense comes from a different root that happens to look the same.
branches.cn: 容器义来自另一个恰好同形的词根。

intro.en: Case expands mainly by compounding and by the -ing and -ment endings, not by classical prefixes.
intro.cn: case 主要靠复合构词以及 -ing、-ment 词尾扩展，不靠古典前缀。

latinIntro.en: Two Latin nouns stand behind the English word: casus for events and capsa for boxes.
latinIntro.cn: 英语这个词背后有两个拉丁名词：表示事件的 casus 和表示盒子的 capsa。

items.example: Casework takes most of her day.
items.exampleCN: 个案工作占了她大半天。

items.meaning: a display case or a chance to show off
items.example: The hall was a showcase for new art.
items.exampleCN: 大厅成了新艺术的展示场。

items.example: He left his briefcase on the train.
items.exampleCN: 他把公文包落在火车上了。

items.meaning: a piece of furniture with shelves
items.example: A tall bookcase filled the wall.

latinEntries.example: Casus is the source of the event sense.
Capsa also gives capsule and cash.
latinEntries.exampleCN: capsa 也是 capsule 与 cash 的来源。

definition_en: money in the form of coins and notes, or to exchange a cheque for money
core_image: 钱箱里随时能拿出来的现钱
scene: 结账时收银员问怎么付款。She paid in cash and put the receipt in her bag.
sceneCN: 这里 cash 指「现金」（第 1 个义项：硬币和纸币形式的钱）；句意是她付了现金，把收据放进包里。

senses.title: Money in coins and notes
senses.definition: money in the form of coins and banknotes rather than cheques or cards
senses.definitionCN: 以硬币和纸币形式存在的钱，而非支票或银行卡
senses.example: He always carries some cash for the bus.
senses.exampleCN: 他总带些现金坐公交。
senses.why: The Latin source meant a money box, and the word shifted from the box to the ready money kept inside it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语源义是钱箱，词义从箱子转到箱子里随时可取的现钱。

senses.title: To exchange a cheque for money
senses.definition: to give or receive coins and notes in exchange for a cheque or other paper
senses.definitionCN: 用支票或其他票据换取硬币和纸币
senses.example: She cashed her salary cheque at the bank.
senses.exampleCN: 她在银行把工资支票兑成了现金。
senses.why: If cash is ready money, the verb names the act of turning paper into that ready money.
senses.whyCN: 既然 cash 是现钱，动词就指把票据变成现钱的动作。

senses.title: Funds available to a business
senses.definition: money that a company or person has available to spend at once
senses.definitionCN: 公司或个人当下可以动用的钱
senses.example: The firm ran out of cash in the spring.
senses.exampleCN: 公司在春天耗尽了资金。
senses.why: For a business, ready money on hand becomes a measure of health, so cash stands for available funds.
senses.whyCN: 对企业而言，手头的现钱成了经营健康的尺度，于是 cash 代指可动用资金。

intro.en: Cash goes back to a Latin word for a box, then to the money box and finally to the money inside.
intro.cn: cash 可追到拉丁语表示盒子的词，再经钱箱义，最后指箱子里的钱。

items.en: Capsa was a box or case, the container that held valuables.
items.cn: 拉丁语 capsa 指盒子或箱子，用来盛放贵重物品。

items.en: Italian cassa named a chest or money box in banking and trade.
items.cn: 意大利语 cassa 在金融和贸易中指钱柜或钱箱。

items.en: Middle French casse carried the money-box sense into northern Europe.
items.cn: 中古法语 casse 把钱箱义带到了北欧。

items.en: English cash first names a money box and soon the coin kept in it.
items.cn: 英语 cash 先指钱箱，很快又指箱里存放的硬币。

items.en: Banking adds the verb sense of cashing a cheque and the phrase cash flow.
items.cn: 银行业务又添上兑现支票的动词义和现金流这一说法。

note.en: The first group shares the money-box root, the second lists other words for money and payment.
note.cn: 第一组共享钱箱这一词根，第二组列出其他表示钱与支付的词。

entries.definition: a person who takes and pays out money
working without coins or notes
a record of money received and paid
the money used in a country
a piece of metal money
an amount paid or the act of paying
entries.definitionCN: 支付的款项或付款行为

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the money-box root, the fixed banking phrases and the short verb forms.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用钱箱词根、固定银行搭配，以及简短的动词形式。

normal.en: Cash and case share a Latin root meaning box, so cash is literally the money in the box.
normal.cn: cash 与 case 共享表示盒子的拉丁词根，cash 字面上就是箱子里的钱。

normal.en: A cashier is the person at the box, the one who takes and gives money.
normal.cn: cashier 就是守着钱箱的人，负责收钱和付钱。

normal.en: Cash flow pictures money moving in and out like water through a pipe.
normal.cn: cash flow 把钱的进出想象成水流过管道。

normal.en: Pay in cash is the everyday phrase that keeps the noun sense alive.
normal.cn: pay in cash 是让名词义保持活跃的日常说法。

normal.en: The third person cashes and the past cashed both keep the short -sh stem.
normal.cn: 三单 cashes 和过去式 cashed 都保留了短短的 -sh 词干。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden box overflowing with coins on a shop counter.
abstract.cn: 想象商店柜台上一个装满硬币的木箱。

abstract.en: Picture notes folded into a wallet before a trip.
abstract.cn: 想象出门前把纸币折好塞进钱包。

abstract.en: Picture a cheque turning into a stack of notes at the bank window.
abstract.cn: 想象一张支票在银行窗口变成一叠钞票。

examples.en: I have no cash with me today.
examples.cn: 我今天身上没带现金。

examples.en: Can you cash this cheque for me?
examples.cn: 你能帮我兑现这张支票吗？

examples.en: The shop only accepts cash.
examples.cn: 这家店只收现金。

dict_mnemonic.text: cash 读音接近「喀什」：想象在喀什的集市上掏出现金买东西。

root: 源自拉丁语 capsa（盒），经意大利语 cassa、中古法语 casse 进入英语，本指钱箱，后指箱中的现钱。

sensesIntro.en: A money box gives the ready money inside it, then the act of turning paper into that money, then the funds a business holds.
sensesIntro.cn: 钱箱先给出箱里的现钱，再给出把票据换成现钱的动作，最后给出企业持有的资金。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a box of ready money kept close at hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只装着现钱、随手可取的钱箱。

branches.en: The notes and coins in the box become the everyday cash sense.
branches.cn: 箱里的纸币和硬币成了日常的现金义。

branches.en: The verb turns a cheque into the contents of the box.
branches.cn: 动词义把支票变成箱子里的东西。

branches.en: For a company the box stands for the funds it can spend now.
branches.cn: 对公司来说，这只箱子代表它眼下能动用的资金。

branches.en: Both senses turn on the same contrast between paper claims and real money.
branches.cn: 两个义项都围绕票据与真钱之间的同一对照。

branches.en: Ready money is both what you carry and what a business measures.
branches.cn: 现钱既是随身携带的钱，也是企业衡量的指标。

intro.en: Cash grows a compact family through the -ier and -less endings and a few compounds.
intro.cn: cash 通过 -ier、-less 词尾和少量复合词形成一个小词族。

latinIntro.en: The ultimate source is Latin capsa, a box, which also underlies case and capsule.
latinIntro.cn: 最终源头是拉丁语 capsa（盒子），case 与 capsule 也出自这里。

items.exampleCN: 这座城市如今几乎不用现金。

items.example: Every entry goes into the cashbook.

items.meaning: the movement of money in and out

definition_zh: 投掷；投射；选派角色；演员阵容；铸造
definition_en: to throw something, to send light or a look in a direction, to choose actors for roles, or to pour metal into a shape
core_image: 把手中的东西用力甩出去
scene: 导演在排练厅里念出名单。The director cast two young actors in the leading roles.
sceneCN: 这里 cast 指「选派角色」（第 2 个义项：为戏剧挑选演员）；句意是导演让两位年轻演员出演主角。

pos.zh: 投掷；投射；选派角色；铸造

senses.title: To throw something
senses.definition: to throw something with force, especially so that it lands some distance away
senses.definitionCN: 用力把某物扔出去，尤指扔到较远处
senses.example: He cast the rope toward the shore.
senses.exampleCN: 他把绳子抛向岸边。
senses.why: The Norse source simply meant to throw, and that physical act remains the core of every later sense.
senses.whyCN: 古诺斯语源词本义就是扔，这个身体动作始终是后面所有义项的核心。

senses.title: To choose actors for roles
senses.definition: to select actors for the parts in a play or film
senses.definitionCN: 为戏剧或电影中的角色挑选演员
senses.example: They cast her as the queen.
senses.exampleCN: 他们让她演女王。
senses.why: Choosing an actor is pictured as throwing a person into a role, as if into a mould.
senses.whyCN: 选演员被想象成把人投进一个角色里，就像投进模具。

senses.title: The group of actors
senses.definition: all the actors who perform in a play or film
senses.definitionCN: 参与一部戏剧或电影演出的全体演员
senses.example: The whole cast came on stage for the applause.
senses.exampleCN: 全体演员上台接受掌声。
senses.why: Once people have been thrown into their parts, the collection of them takes the same noun.
senses.whyCN: 人一旦被投进各自的角色，这一群人就沿用了同一个名词。

senses.title: To send light or a look
senses.definition: to cause light, shadow or a glance to fall on something
senses.definitionCN: 使光、影或目光落到某物上
senses.example: The tall buildings cast long shadows.
senses.exampleCN: 高楼投下长长的影子。
senses.why: Light thrown from a source behaves like an object thrown forward, so the verb covers casting shadows.
senses.whyCN: 从光源甩出的光就像被抛出的物体，于是动词也覆盖了投下影子。

senses.title: To pour metal into a mould
senses.definition: to pour melted metal into a shaped container so that it hardens into an object
senses.definitionCN: 把熔化的金属倒入模具，冷却后成为物件
senses.example: The workers cast the bell in one piece.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们一次浇铸成了这口钟。
senses.why: Molten metal is literally thrown into a mould, keeping the old sense of a forceful pour.
senses.whyCN: 熔化的金属确实是被「倒抛」进模具，保留了用力倾倒的旧义。

intro.en: Cast came from Old Norse rather than Latin, and one physical sense of throwing spread into acting, light and metalwork.
intro.cn: cast 来自古诺斯语而非拉丁语，一个扔的动作向外扩展到表演、光线和金属加工。

items.en: A reconstructed verb for throwing or tossing underlies the Norse word.
items.cn: 一般认为有一个表示投掷的原始日耳曼语动词，是诺斯语词的来源。

items.en: Kasta meant to throw, and Norse settlers brought it into northern English.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 kasta 意为投掷，随北欧移民进入英格兰北部。

items.en: Casten spreads from throwing objects to throwing light, looks and dice.
items.cn: 中古英语 casten 从扔物体扩展到投光、投目光和掷骰子。

items.en: Metalwork gives the sense of pouring molten metal into a mould.
items.cn: 金属加工带来把熔融金属倒入模具的义项。

items.en: The theatre takes cast for the selection of actors and then for the whole company.
items.cn: 十七世纪戏剧界用 cast 指挑选演员，进而指整个演员班底。

items.en: Modern English keeps all these branches, from casting a vote to a plaster cast.
items.cn: 现代英语保留全部分支，从投票到石膏铸型。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the casting and throwing family, while the meaning group lists other throwing verbs.
note.cn: 形近组沿铸造与投掷词族展开，近义组列出其他表示扔的动词。

a person who casts metal, or a small wheel
a person left alone after a shipwreck
